site.metaDescription: Black Orchid Tribe — rock, blues, folk. The project of NAYAR (formerly Loïc Videtta). Music, live, press, contact.

hero.photoAlt: NAYAR on vocals with Black Orchid Tribe, on the set of the Feel The Tribe video
hero.subtitle: Born from a chasm between body and soul, **Black Orchid Tribe** is the story of **NAYAR** — formerly Loïc Videtta — a Belgian-Italian singer-songwriter who lends it his voice through rock steeped in *nomadic folk* and *tribal blues*.

blocks.text: Powerful, desert-tinged riffs, incantations and inhabited silences, an instinctive, ancestral folk shot through with a **shamanic imagination**, fed by journeys to the far reaches of **Siberia**. The voice moves from restraint to saturation — the singing turns now *chanted mantra*, now *whispered confession*.

images.alt: NAYAR in a quarry lake, arm outstretched under the spray

blocks.text: Born in 2021, the project revealed itself along the way: three singles — *Numb My Beast*, *Better Run*, *Inside My Head* — and the EP ***Back Home*** (November 15, 2022), carried by its anthem *Feel The Tribe*, extended by three music videos and a live session. The first two singles took shape at **Koko Records**, produced by Laurent Eyen. The press followed from the very first releases — **RTBF, Classic 21, Nostalgie, L'Avenir, Larsen, Musiczine** — and the stage was quick to answer.

images.alt: NAYAR at the microphone surrounded by the band, on the set of the Feel The Tribe video

blocks.text: A first fracture happened on stage, in the middle of the *Back Home* promo tour — the measure of how much he gives, physically, at every show. A second, more serious one, meant two operations and a long rehabilitation: severely limited in movement, he rediscovered the essential — **a voice, a guitar, songs** that never needed the whole body to exist fully. Out of that ordeal came a clear vision for 2026-2027: ***Both Knees***, a mirrored double album, *Left* and *Right* — one side **unplugged and authentic**, one side **immersive, electric and devastating**, a faithful reflection of what Black Orchid Tribe delivers on stage.

images.alt: NAYAR lying on stage amid the crowd, live at Le Lac in Brussels

blocks.text: That vision is being built patiently. Spotted by **Black Mirrors** (Napalm Records), he became their bass player: some **twenty countries** on international tour, more than a **hundred shows**, a **Decibel Music Award** in 2019 — stage experience that still shapes the way he thinks Black Orchid Tribe today. Even before that, as guitarist and songwriter, he had founded and led **Mango Moon** to two contest wins and a hundred Belgian and French stages — the same builder's energy from day one. *Projects evolve, the vision sharpens.*

On stage with Black Mirrors

intention.title: Candidature au Concours Circuit 2026
intention.photoAlt: NAYAR au micro entouré du groupe, tournage du clip Feel The Tribe
paragraphs: Cette candidature s'inscrit dans la **stratégie 2026-2027** de Black Orchid Tribe, pas comme une initiative isolée : celle du **retour à la scène** après une année de revalidation, avec un format libéré de toute contrainte — **seul à la guitare, ou en power duo** — et une œuvre à venir, ***Both Knees***, qui porte cette polyvalence jusque dans sa structure.

Premier jalon de ce plan : ***Back Home Unplugged***, une session captée en pleine nature dès la fin de l'été — retour aux sources avant le retour de scène, pensé comme le premier chapitre visible d'un récit à suivre. Cette reconstruction ne reste pas en marge : elle devient la matière même de *Both Knees*, documentée et déployée au fil de sa création à travers les réseaux, pour **embarquer la communauté** qui suit NAYAR et Black Orchid Tribe depuis leurs différents chapitres.

L'accompagnement du **Concours Circuit** — résidence, coaching scénique, structuration — s'inscrit directement dans cette dynamique : **le levier qui peut amplifier l'écho de Both Knees et le message de Black Orchid Tribe** au moment précis où ce plan prend forme.

live.title: Live
live.intro: On stage, the project quickly found its footing: the **Baudet'stival**, played several times over, stands as a milestone — **stage performance award** on the very first appearance, in 2022. Black Orchid Tribe also opened for Montreal's **The Damn Truth**, and keeps adding Belgian stages to the list.

press.title: In the press

quotes.text: What Black Orchid Tribe gives us back is music that is free — no restriction, no shame, no fear.
A subtle cross between a form of 90s grunge and a Dead Man-like Sioux blues tinged with great-plains folk.

crafter.title: Crafter
crafter.text: On stage and in the studio, NAYAR plays **Crafter** electric and acoustic guitars — **brand ambassador** for the European and Asian launch of their *Crema* electric model in 2024.
